# Begapunk

> Begapunk is a Ningbo, China manufacturer of pneumatic rotary joints, air rotary unions, multi-passage rotary unions, and custom fluid-transfer solutions for industrial machinery.

Begapunk serves OEM machine builders, automation companies, equipment manufacturers, and distributors. Product selection depends on the medium, pressure, rotational speed, passage count, port size, mounting method, duty cycle, and operating environment.

Standard catalog models are primarily intended for pneumatic and compatible low-pressure fluid-transfer applications. High-pressure hydraulic, excavator, crane, construction, mining, drilling, and other mobile-equipment projects require a custom engineering evaluation.

## Product models

- [BP-1P-0003](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-1P-0003.html): 1-in-1-out threaded rotary joint, maximum pressure 1 MPa.
- [BP-1P-0006](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-1P-0006.html): 1-in-6-out rotary joint with 4 mm orifices and G1/8 connections.
- [BP-2P-0001](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-2P-0001.html): 2-in-2-out flange-mounted rotary joint, maximum pressure 1 MPa.
- [BP-2P-0002](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-2P-0002.html): 2-in-3-out rotary joint with 4 mm orifices and G1/8 connections.
- [BP-2P-08-0001](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-2P-08-0001.html): Compact 2-in-2-out rotary joint with M5 threaded mounting.
- [BP-2P-16-0001](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-2P-16-0001.html): 2-in-2-out flange-mounted rotary joint with a 16 mm bore.
- [BP-2P-30-0001](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-2P-30-0001.html): 2-in-2-out flange-mounted rotary joint with a 30 mm bore.
- [BP-2P-50-0001](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-2P-50-0001.html): Dust-resistant 2-in-2-out flange-mounted rotary joint.
- [BP-2P-95-0001](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-2P-95-0001.html): 2-in-4-out rotary joint, maximum pressure 1 MPa.
- [BP-2P-130-0001](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-2P-130-0001.html): Heavy-duty 2-in-2-out rotary joint, maximum pressure 5 MPa.
- [BP-3P-0004](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-3P-0004.html): 3-in-3-out flange-mounted rotary joint, maximum pressure 1 MPa.
- [BP-3P-0006](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-3P-0006.html): 3-in-3-out rotary joint with 6 mm orifices and G1/4 connections.
- [BP-3P-0007](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-3P-0007.html): 3-in-3-out rotary joint with 4 mm orifices and G1/8 connections.
- [BP-3P-S06-0001](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-3P-S06-0001.html): Combined 3-passage pneumatic and 6-circuit electrical rotary joint.
- [BP-4P-30-0001](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-4P-30-0001.html): 4-in-4-out flange-mounted rotary joint with a 30 mm bore.
- [BP-8P-0001](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-8P-0001.html): 8-in-8-out flange-mounted rotary joint, maximum pressure 1 MPa.
